metadata.sourceMethod: Route evidence now scans the CHSC 2025/2026 senior subject-offering fields and explicit programme statements in school-based curriculum, relevant school-profile notes and route-specific fee notes. Only named routes are tagged; future planned routes are stored separately with a target year. Tags are discovery clues, not rankings or admission recommendations; no tag does not mean a route is absent.
